headline: Sheikh Hasina and 33 others indicted in truck driver killing case
summary: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and 33 others have been formally charged in a case related to the death of a truck driver during protests in July 2024. Arrest warrants have been issued for absconding accused, including Hasina.
details: A special court in Dhaka has framed charges against former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and 33 other individuals in connection with the killing of a truck driver during the July protests. The indictment marks a significant step in the legal proceedings.

The case centers on the death of 25-year-old truck driver Mohammad Hossain, who was killed in Dhaka's Mohammadpur area on July 19, 2024. His mother initially filed a murder case accusing Hasina and 15 others, which was later registered as a First Information Report.

During yesterday's hearing, eleven accused, including former state minister Zunaid Ahmed Palak and former lawmaker Sadek Khan, pleaded not guilty. Nine of the accused, including Palak and Sadek, are currently in jail and were presented in court.

Arrest warrants have been issued for 23 individuals who are currently absconding, including Sheikh Hasina and several former ministers. The court has scheduled November 25 for the recording of prosecution witness statements.

headline: Winds up to 117kmph: Arnab grows into severe cyclone in Bay of Bengal
summary: The Bangladesh Meteorological Department has issued warning signal No. 3 for four seaports as the storm moves west-northwest.
details: Cyclone Arnab has intensified into a severe cyclonic storm over the east-central Bay of Bengal and adjoining west-central waters. The storm is moving west-northwest, according to the Bangladesh Meteorological Department.
At 6pm on Sunday, the storm's centre was located 870km southwest of Chittagong Port, 810km southwest of Cox’s Bazar, 795km south of Mongla and 770km south of Payra.
Winds near the centre are blowing continuously at up to 89km per hour within a 64km radius, with gusts reaching 117km per hour. The sea remains rough near the storm’s centre.
The Met Office has instructed Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Mongla and Payra seaports to maintain local warning signal No. 3.
Fishing boats and trawlers in the North Bay have been advised to remain close to the coast and proceed with caution until further notice.
The storm is expected to intensify further into a — ‘very severe’ cyclonic storm before it crosses India’s Andhra coast on Wednesday.

Winds near the centre are blowing continuously at up to 89km per hour within a 64km radius, with gusts reaching 117km per hour. The sea remains rough near the storm’s centre.

The Met Office has instructed Chattogram, Cox’s Bazar, Mongla and Payra seaports to maintain local warning signal No. 3.

Fishing boats and trawlers in the North Bay have been advised to remain close to the coast and proceed with caution until further notice.

The storm is expected to intensify further into a — ‘very severe’ cyclonic storm before it crosses India’s Andhra coast on Wednesday.
